portal: SCW — Senior Citizens Welfare (UAT) · Full Design QC

baseline._modes: tokens (strict, vs inputs/tokens.json) | derived (from Figma variables) | internal (no DS — flag outliers)
baseline._why_internal: MUST stay 'internal' until inputs/tokens.json is a real design-variable export. Its current values were sampled from the LIVE BUILD's computed CSS (the Figma MCP could not resolve SCW's design nodes — see the _note in tokens.json). Running mode 'tokens' against a build-derived baseline is CIRCULAR: it compares the build to itself and reports near-zero deviations by construction — a false green that looks like a passing DS-conformance audit. 'internal' is the honest mode for a build-derived baseline: no design truth asserted, just outliers flagged. Switch to 'tokens' ONLY after re-running Phase 0 with the SCW page open in the Figma desktop app so get_variable_defs returns real variables.

notes: Passwords are NOT stored here and MUST NOT be. Put them in projects/scw/secrets.json (gitignored), keyed by role name ('admin') — see secrets.example.json for the shape. The 'public' role needs no secret (auth:none), which is why the 10 scw-user-uat screens run unattended. The 8 scw-admin-uat screens stay skipped until a human supplies the admin credential. NOTE: the demo credentials in .claude/rules/portal-login-demos.md are for the LOCAL prototype at localhost:3000/portals/scw — they are NOT the credentials for this real UAT host, so do not copy them here.
